lines: Butanone is CH_{3}COCH_{2}CH_{3} - it has the C = O group in the middle of the carbon chain.
(1) A permanent magnet like a bar magnet or a horse-shoe magnet has a magnetic field around it.
(2) When an electric current flows through a conductor (a straight wire, a circular loop or a solenoid), a magnetic field is produced around it.

Plants take carbon dioxide from the air through the stomata in the leaves. Water and minerals are absorbed from the soil by the roots and carried up by the xylem. Sunlight is absorbed by the chlorophyll present in the leaves.

lines.text: (ii) Moist blue litmus paper turns red, because SO_{2} dissolves in water to form sulphurous acid.
